npx projectstore install - Install projectstore's surfaces for a harness,
  behind a preview.

Usage
  npx projectstore install [options]

Options
  --harness <id>   the harness - and, without a terminal, the confirmation (a
                   terminal is asked); there is no --yes (repeatable)
  --surface <key>  one surface and those beneath it (repeatable)
  --no-register    leave the plugin registration alone: change only this
                   project's files
  --verbose        every row's reasoning, each step's why and the host's own
                   notes
  --json           the envelope

Harnesses   claude-code, codex

Examples

  npx projectstore install --harness <id>

  The same plan; nothing is written:
  npx projectstore plan --harness <id>

Exit codes  0 ok, 1 findings or a refusal, 2 usage, 3 not bound, 130 cancelled
